requirements.text: Degree or vocational qualification in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Tax, or a comparable field
Several years of hands-on experience in financial accounting, accounts payable, payment operations, and month-end closing
Sound knowledge of German GAAP and VAT requirements
Experience coordinating accounting activities across German and Dutch entities
Proven ability to manage external accountants and service providers
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA or a comparable ERP system
Ideally FI processes and an implementation or rollout of an ERP system
At least basic skills in German for day-to-day collaboration
Confidence to take ownership of operational topics from start to finish

resumes.text:
Elena Voss
Senior Accountant

Summary
Finance professional with nine years of experience in accounts payable, financial accounting and month-end close for growing international companies. Highly structured, reliable and detail-oriented, with a steady hand under deadline pressure. Fluent in English.

Experience
Senior Accountant, Lindqvist Industries GmbH, Hamburg (2019 to present)
- Prepared VAT returns and annual financial statements under HGB for two German GmbH entities, meeting every statutory deadline.
- Managed the external accounting firm, briefing them on requirements, resolving open questions and tracking deliverables for the year-end close.
- Owned the full accounts payable cycle, from invoice intake and validation through approval workflows to payment runs.
- Led the finance workstream of an SAP S/4HANA rollout, covering FI configuration, master data migration and user testing.
- Coordinated month-end closings for UK and French subsidiaries, reconciling intercompany balances every month.
- Took every operational finance topic from first booking to final sign-off, without needing supervision.

Accountant, Fenwick Logistics Ltd, London (2015 to 2019)
- Processed around 1,500 supplier invoices a month and supported the month-end close.
- Maintained the bank reconciliation and open-item lists for the group.
- Supported the migration from a legacy ledger to a new accounting package.

Education
BSc Accounting and Finance, London South Bank University, 2015
Certificate in Bookkeeping, Association of Accounting Technicians, 2013

Skills
Accounts payable, financial accounting, month-end close, VAT, HGB reporting, SAP S/4HANA, FI configuration, Microsoft Excel, English (fluent).

Ruth Adair
Accounts Payable Specialist

Summary
Accounts professional with four years of experience processing supplier invoices and supporting month-end work for a mid-sized services group. Detail-oriented and dependable, with good communication skills. Fluent in English and conversational Dutch.

Experience
Accounts Payable Specialist, Tidewater Services Group, Bristol (2021 to present)
- Processes around 2,000 supplier invoices a month, from intake and coding through to payment runs.
- Manages two external accounting firms and service providers, setting requirements and tracking their deliverables.
- Prepares monthly reporting packs under US GAAP for the group's US parent company.
- Keeps the approval queue moving by chasing managers for sign-off, so the finance calendar stays on time.
- Supports the month-end book close by preparing supporting schedules and clearing open items.
- Keeps a close eye on every figure before it leaves the team, catching errors early.
- I take ownership of my operational tasks from start to finish.

Junior Bookkeeper, Greenmere Landscaping, Bristol (2019 to 2021)
- Maintained sales and purchase ledgers in Excel-based workbooks.
- Reconciled the company bank account each week.
- Issued customer invoices and tracked payment chasing.

Education
BA Accounting and Finance, University of the West of England, 2019

Skills
Accounts payable, invoice processing, bank reconciliation, supplier communication, Microsoft Excel, English (fluent).

Dan Pryce
Bar and Floor Supervisor

Summary
Hospitality supervisor with seven years of experience running busy restaurants and bars. Good with cash handling and customer service. Fluent in English. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration.

Experience
Bar and Floor Supervisor, The Anchor Quay, Cardiff (2019 to present)
- Oversees till cash, tips and daily takings for a 120-seat bar.
- Handled supplier deliveries and checked supplier invoices against the order sheet before the manager signed them off.
- Trains staff on opening and closing procedures and on the point-of-sale system.
- Manages the rota and holiday planning for twelve staff.
- Runs weekly stock counts and places replenishment orders with suppliers.

Restaurant Team Leader, Olive and Thyme, Cardiff (2016 to 2019)
- Handled cash handling for lunch and dinner service with no discrepancies at close.
- Dealt with supplier queries about late deliveries and short-supplied stock.
- Covered shifts for the kitchen and front-of-house teams when needed.
- Organised staff events and seasonal menu tastings.

Bar Staff, The Plough Inn, Penarth (2014 to 2016)
- Served customers at a busy weekend bar and kept the bar area clean and stocked.
- Took payments by card and cash, balancing the till at the end of each shift.

Education
BA Business Administration, Cardiff Metropolitan University, 2016

Skills
Customer service, cash handling, staff training, rota planning, supplier ordering, stock control, Microsoft Word, English (fluent).
